args.subject: Child Seat Availability - New Car Rental, London
args.body:
Hello,

I hope this message finds you well. I am planning to rent a car from New Car Rental in London and would like to ask whether you have child seats available.

Could you please let me know:
- Whether child seats are available for rental
- The types of child seats you offer (infant, booster, etc.)
- Whether they are included in the rental price or available as an add-on
- Any age or weight requirements, and whether advance booking is recommended

Thank you in advance for your help. I look forward to hearing from you.

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
Email: emma.johnson@bluesparrowtech.com
Phone: 327-420-4923
